Sound familiar?

If bedtime has become the hardest hour of the day, you are not doing it wrong — you just need a better wind-down.

“Bedtime takes an hour and ends in tears.”The routine stretches on, nobody settles, and the whole house feels it by morning.

“Your child asks for ‘one more’ over and over.”One more story, one more drink of water, one more anything — because stopping feels abrupt.

“You are exhausted and want your evenings back.”After a full day of giving, the last thing you have left is one more performance at the bedside.

Willow Tales gives bedtime a shape: open a story, flip or listen, and let the book do the settling — the same calm ritual, every night.

What's inside Willow Tales

One library, seven books, three ways to enjoy every story night.

3D Flipbook Reader

Pages turn like a real book. Your child taps to flip through each story at their own pace — hands busy, mind settling.

Read-Aloud Narration

Stories that read themselves aloud, so you can listen side by side — or let the narration carry story time on the nights you are running on empty.

Lottie the Story Friend

A friendly companion inside the app who shares stories and gentle fun — a familiar face that makes the bedtime ritual something to look forward to.

Meet the creator

Ting Lott, RN — 17 years of nursing in psychiatric and crisis care (Crisis and Navigation RN), and before nursing, 5 years as an elementary school teacher.

That is the heart behind Willow Tales: a teacher who knows how children settle into a story, and a nurse who has spent years helping people find calm in the hardest hours of the night. These books were made to bring both kinds of care to your child's bedtime.

— Ting Lott, ARTISY / T. Lott Creative

Questions, answered

What do I need?

No special equipment. A phone, tablet, or computer with a browser is enough — Willow Tales opens right in the browser, with nothing to install.

How do I start?

Two easy ways: start free on Whop, or open the live library directly. When you are ready for the whole collection to keep, the $14.99 Gumroad package is the full library.

Is Franklin of Gluntenburg a read-along book?

Franklin of Gluntenburg is an audio story — made to listen to, lights low, rather than flip through. The other six books open in the flipbook reader.

Tonight could be the calm one.

Open a story, flip a few pages or press play, and let bedtime end the way it should — quietly, together.
